title: Federal Register – Proposed Rules Scraper & Public Inspection
description: Scrape the US Federal Register from its regulatory data API: rules, proposed rules, notices and presidential documents. 37 flat fields incl. comment-close deadline, EO 12866 significance, RIN and CFR refs. Also reads the Public Inspection desk — a rule 1-3 days before it publishes. No start fee.
